description: This file defines the class PolicyQueryCommandAdapter, which serves as an adapter for mapping PolicyQueryCommand objects to and from an Adaptable within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter framework. It extends AbstractPolicyAdapter and implements QueryCommandAdapter, providing functionality to create adapter instances and retrieve type criteria from TopicPath objects.

classes.name: PolicyQueryCommandAdapter
classes.description: A final class acting as an adapter for mapping PolicyQueryCommand objects to and from an Adaptable, facilitating integration within the Eclipse Ditto protocol framework.

methods.name: PolicyQueryCommandAdapter
methods.description: Private constructor initializing the adapter with specific mapping strategies, a signal mapper, and a header translator.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Public static factory method for creating new instances of PolicyQueryCommandAdapter with the provided HeaderTranslator.

methods.name: getTypeCriterionAsString
methods.description: Protected method to extract a string criterion from a given TopicPath object by accessing its criterion's name.
